unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4A
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4A — Empty library. Header my encyclopedias is shown with the empty-state artwork/copy including nothing here yet! ☆; the user is prompted toward creating/saving material. - GOOD but make the text ‘nothing here yet! ☆’.

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4B
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4B — Populated library. Book tiles represent saved encyclopedias. Search and sort controls alter which books are shown and their order. - When the user has one or more saved encyclopedias, the decorative bookshelf must remain exactly the same as the decorative bookshelf shown in the Empty Library state. Do not layer, redistribute, or add duplicate SavedLibrary artwork onto the bookshelf in the populated state. This includes the books, book stack, bookmark, flower, potted plant, label, or any other artwork already present in the canonical bookshelf composition. The user’s actual saved encyclopedias remain in the separate coded collection underneath and do not alter the decorative bookshelf. Empty state bookshelf = populated state bookshelf. No duplicated decorative artwork.

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4C
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4C — Search with matches. Only matching encyclopedias remain visible. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4D
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4D — Search with no matches. The library shows its no-result state rather than books. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4E
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4E — Sort menu collapsed/expanded. The sort picker toggles between a quiet control and its list of sort choices: recently updated, alphabetical, newest, oldest. - GOOD; add code to ensure that these are easily accessible to the user.

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4F
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4F — Create encyclopedia popup. A watercolor popup contains title entry and cover/style choices. Blank title and library-limit failures can appear inside the popup. - GOOD. - Also the titles and description of the encyclopedias must have a character limit appropriate for the space constraints - AND a non-explicit rule [no profanity, violence, or anything crude[don’t just ban the word ‘sex’ b/c user can have a guide on sexual health or something’]]; and they should appear below the guide in an aesthetic fashion rather than being bunched up on it.

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4G
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4G — Rename popup. Existing title is editable; validation/persistence failure can keep the popup open with an error. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4H
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4H — Delete confirmation popup. The selected encyclopedia remains in the background while the confirmation popup asks for the destructive action. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4I
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4I — Library full. At the coded maximum, creation is disabled/redirected to the “full library” popup rather than creating another encyclopedia. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4J
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4J — Book-opening animation. Opening a book is staged through idle → spine → front → closed → open; different book artwork is visible during those stages. - Implement this entirely in code so the user’s selected book colour and all other dynamic book properties are preserved. Use the provided book-opening artwork only as the exact visual reference for how the coded book should look; do not use staged image swaps to create the animation. Create a continuous, fully animated book-opening sequence in code, beginning from the user’s already-present book spine in their selected colour. Seamlessly transition that same book from its bookshelf position into the coded book as it moves forward and centers directly in front of the user like a popup, then physically opens from closed → partially open → fully open through continuous animation rather than discrete stages. Once fully open, DO NOT zoom into the right-hand page. Instead, continuously transform and reposition the entire coded open book into the exact final size, position, orientation, and layout used by the inside-book view. The whole open book must remain visibly present as the persistent container for the inside-book experience, with the user’s actual saved content appearing on/in the appropriate pages once the book settles into its final inside-book position. The transition into the inside-book state must therefore occur through the movement and settling of the complete coded open book itself—not through a camera zoom into one page, replacement with another book representation, or handoff to a separate page-only view. The entire sequence must read as one continuous physical interaction: existing coloured book spine → same book comes forward and centers → same book continuously opens → fully open book → complete open book smoothly moves/scales into its final inside-book position → inside-book content appears within that same book. Preserve the user’s selected book colour and all applicable dynamic book properties throughout the entire transition and resulting inside-book state. There must be no visual jump, asset swap, duplicated book, disappearing book, page-only zoom, reset to a default colour, or obvious handoff between the bookshelf book, opening animation, and final inside-book view.

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4K
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4K — Encyclopedia detail. Inside a book, chapters/pages are shown. Chapter sections can be expanded/collapsed. - Remove the small library_book_open artwork currently rendered inside the open book. The book itself must be the coded fully open book in the user’s selected book colour, carried seamlessly from the opening animation (placed at the TOP and CENTERED in the screen; aesthetically pleasing). Do not place another book inside it. Keep all other inside-book content, layout, and behavior unchanged. Also remove the extra art on the bottom (the bookmark and the flower).

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4L
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4L — Saved page reading. Selecting a page opens its saved question/body. A full-answer page shows the saved full answer; an excerpt page shows the excerpt. Source metadata and notes are available where present.

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 4M
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 4M — Ask save destination. When Ask sends content here, the destination UI can have no encyclopedia selected, an encyclopedia selected but no chapter, both selected, new-encyclopedia creation open, validation error, and final successful save. - GOOD.

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5A
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5A — Empty guide shelf. Header build your own guide is visible with folder/bow/star/Blueberry decoration and your bookshelf is waiting. :-). If no saved material exists, the page also explains that there is nothing available to build from and provides go to ask. NEW TEXT: your bookshelf is waiting. :-), everything else GOOD.

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5B
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5B — Populated guide shelf. Existing guides appear as selectable guide objects with their chosen cover style. - GOOD.

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5C
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5C — Create guide overlay. The user names/creates a new guide in an overlay. - GOOD; ensure popup rules apply.

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5D
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5D — Selected guide editor. The guide’s name, optional subtitle/description, cover, saved-page count, sections, contents, and guide actions are visible. - GOOD BUT Remove guide folder from behind the selected guide. This state should display only the isolated guide spine in the user’s selected colour/style. Keep everything else unchanged. Guide folder should appear only in the initial/beginning Guide Builder state. Once a guide is selected or being edited, remove the folder entirely and display only the isolated guide spine in the user’s selected colour/style. Keep everything else unchanged.

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5E
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5E — Guide options closed/open. guide options reveals rename, change cover, description, and delete actions. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5F
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5F — Rename / description / cover overlays. Each edits one guide property without leaving the guide. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5G
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5G — Delete guide confirmation. Destructive confirmation overlays the guide state. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5H
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5H — Empty guide contents. Copy such as your sections will gather here as you build. / make a section, then tuck your saved pages inside! <3 appears when structure is absent. - GOOD BUT KEEP IN MIND NEW TEXT: your sections will gather here as you build. / make a section, then tuck your saved pages inside! <3

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5I
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5I — Add section. + new section opens the section-creation path. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5J
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5J — Populated sections. Sections list their pages. Section-level rename/reorder controls appear when the corresponding mode is active. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5K
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5K — Empty section. nothing tucked into this section yet! is shown. - GOOD (my only change is added the exclamation point)

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5L
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5L — Add saved pages. A picker exposes saved encyclopedia material, filters it, and lets pages be inserted into the guide. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5M
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5M — Page actions. A guide page can be moved, annotated with add a note, opened via view original when linked to a source saved page, reordered, or removed. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5N
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5N — Read mode. read my guide changes from editing/contents into the assembled reading experience. - GOOD

unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.label: 5O
unnumbered_founder_paragraphs.text: 5O — Save confirmation / celebration.  After a successful save action, a temporary saved-status confirmation and/or appropriate Strawberry celebration may appear, then dismiss automatically. - Use Strawberry with “saved!” directly underneath inside the existing control large card artwork used for popups. Scale the card down slightly for this confirmation so it feels compact and celebratory rather than overbearing, while preserving its proportions and existing visual style.
